type2_improved_unchanged.interpretation: Pack improved but no observable Human benefit (dominant pattern)

semantic_boundary_reassessment.note: All UNCERTAIN are either EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT or NOT_DETERMINABLE. No semantic boundary confirmed.

parallel_split_confounding.impact: M3 increase (+2) could be partially caused by difficulty imbalance, not Pack content

p0_vs_p1_translation.not_contradictory: P0=content improved (objective), P1=human benefit not confirmed (subjective, small N)
p0_vs_p1_translation.explanation: Low translation rate due to: MINOR changes dominant, difficulty confound, M3 construct mismatch, low power

research_question_answers.Q1_134_events: 120 first-selections + 14 actual revisions. NOT 134 judgment changes.

research_question_answers.Q5_m3_increase: INCONCLUSIVE. Multiple hypotheses partially consistent. +2 from 2 single-case stratum differences.
research_question_answers.Q7_failure_pattern: NO systematic failure. Type 3 = genuine Evidence gap (DEF=0).
research_question_answers.Q8_continue_optimization: INCONCLUSIVE. P0 proved improvement, P1 no regression, but no confirmed benefit.
